audience: businesses that send SMS through their own ASPSMS account

useCases.title: Check the credit balance
useCases.text: Read the remaining ASPSMS credit balance of the account.

useCases.title: Check if an SMS was delivered
useCases.text: Read the delivery status of SMS sent with a transaction reference.

useCases.title: Send an SMS
useCases.text: Check the credits. Then send an SMS to up to 1000 recipients after you confirm the text. Sends spend credit and cannot be recalled.

useCases.title: Unlock a sender number
useCases.text: Unlock a phone number as sender with the code that ASPSMS sent to that number.
